description: Generate invoice numbers: the next number after a given one (keeping its prefix and zero padding), or a run of numbers in a chosen format (prefix, separator, optional year or month, number of digits) from a starting number.

digits.description: Digits in the number; defaults to 4

lastNumber.description: The last number used, e.g. INV-0041

prefix.description: Letters, numbers and single hyphens, e.g. INV

name: generate_invoice_numbers
title: Generate invoice numbers
